comment: Trial assets downloaded by tools/fetch-trial-assets.mjs into public/trial/ (gitignored). All from Poly Haven, CC0 (https://polyhaven.com/license). Each entry names a Poly Haven asset id, its kind and resolution: an hdri gives its file format; a texture lists the maps to fetch (Poly Haven map names: Diffuse = albedo (a set with color variants names them col_1, col_2, ...), Rough = roughness, nor_gl = OpenGL-convention normal map) and their format (every 2k map here is 2048 x 2048, so any of them can share a scene: a scene's images share one layer size); a model is fetched as glTF with its .bin and textures and converted to OBJ by tools/gltf-to-obj.mjs.
